titan_base.name: Titan Salvage Station
titan_base.desc: The last free dock in the Saturn system. Scorch marks, salt-stained bulkheads, and the smell of pitch burners. A chart broker works the corner.

titan_orbit.name: Titan Orbit
titan_orbit.desc: A cluttered parking orbit above the orange haze. Traffic wakes drift past the station.

lane_rhea_1.name: Titan-Rhea Lane
lane_rhea_1.desc: The shipping lane toward Rhea. Raider sign: old scorch on the guard buoys.

lane_rhea_2.name: Titan-Rhea Lane
lane_rhea_2.desc: Half-way to Rhea. Keep the gun warm.

rhea.name: Rhea Orbit
rhea.desc: An ice moon turned scavver camp. Wreck fields orbit with it.

lane_saturn_1.name: Rhea-Saturn Approach
lane_saturn_1.desc: The rings grow ahead, a bright wall of stone and ice.

lane_saturn_2.name: Rhea-Saturn Approach
lane_saturn_2.desc: Ring particles ping off the hull like rain.

saturn_jp.name: Saturn Jump Point
saturn_jp.desc: The system's outer gate, beyond the last ring shepherd. The beacon chain beyond is dark: the bugs took it.

lane_drift_1.name: The Drift
lane_drift_1.desc: A slow river of rock between Titan and the grave fields.

asteroid_tick.name: A Riddled Asteroid
asteroid_tick.desc: A pitted rock, honeycombed with bore-holes. Something inside is breathing.

lane_mimas_1.name: Titan-Mimas Lane
lane_mimas_1.desc: A quiet run past the shepherding wrecks.

mimas.name: Mimas Orbit
mimas.desc: The death-star moon, hollowed long ago by the first evacuation.

lane_enceladus_1.name: Titan-Enceladus Lane
lane_enceladus_1.desc: Geyser plumes from the ice moon streak the lane below.

enceladus.name: Enceladus Orbit
enceladus.desc: Ice-geyser territory. The plumes hide movement.

arena_start.name: Titan Combat Arena
arena_start.desc: A circular combat ring on Titan's surface, marked by burning sandstone pillars. Fight to clear it.

arena_2.name: Mimas Arena
arena_2.desc: Frozen arena in Mimas' hollow crater. Ice cracks echo with every strike.

arena_3.name: Rhea Arena
arena_3.desc: An icy battleground on Rhea. The ice is cold; the fight burns hotter.
